hero.subtitle: AAANYIM digitizes the production, delivery and sales chain for perishable goods — sachet water, bakery, gas, grocery — for African producers.
hero.trust: Already used in 3 West African countries

problem.title: African producers lose up to 30% of their production

cards.title: Notebook & WhatsApp management
cards.desc: No visibility on stock, orders get lost, impossible to plan production.

cards.title: Untraceable cash in transit
cards.desc: Drivers collect money without receipts. Losses and discrepancies are daily, with no way to verify.

cards.title: Expired & unsold goods
cards.desc: Without demand data, producers manufacture blindly. Result: overstock or stockout.

solution.title: A complete ERP designed for African field operations

features.title: Multi-sector catalog
features.desc: Water, gas, bakery, grocery — one tool for all perishable goods. Configurable catalog per tenant.

features.title: 100% Offline-first
features.desc: Create lots, confirm deliveries, scan containers — even without network. Auto-sync when connection returns.

features.title: Built-in wallet & escrow
features.desc: Mobile payment (Flooz, T-Money, MoMo), automatic escrow during delivery, transparent commissions.

features.title: Shared transport
features.desc: Optimize routes, track each stop via QR code, confirm delivery in real-time with photo proof.

features.title: Anti-waste AI
features.desc: Production recommendations based on actual demand from the last 7 days. Produce exactly what's needed.

features.title: Multi-country & multi-currency
features.desc: Togo (XOF), Cameroon (XAF), Ghana (GHS), Senegal, Benin, Ivory Coast — one account, all markets.

steps.title: Sign up
steps.desc: Create your manager account in 2 minutes. Your workspace is ready immediately with your product catalog.

steps.title: Set up your team
steps.desc: Add your drivers and resellers. Each gets a mobile app with features tailored to their role.

steps.title: Produce & deliver
steps.desc: Create batches, track deliveries in real-time, collect payments via mobile money. Zero paper, zero cash.

pricing.title: A price that fits every business size
